headline: India’s NSE becomes world’s fifth-largest listed stock exchange operator
summary: Shares of National Stock Exchange of India rose 2.8% to ₹2,251, making it the fifth-largest publicly traded stock exchange operator globally by market capitalization. The valuation surpassed US-based Nasdaq Inc. and Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing.
why: The National Stock Exchange of India is the primary equity exchange operator in India, benefitting from booming domestic trading volumes.

impacts.name: NSE India
impacts.why: Strong investor demand lifted exchange operator shares by 2.8% to record valuation levels.
